title: 30A Grayt'n Greatful
meta_description: 30A Grayt'n Greatful --- 3BR historic-luxe Grayton home with porch swing, carriage house, walkable beach access \& iconic Red Bar just steps away.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THIS HOME: Step back in time and experience the charm of Grayton Beach, the original 30A beach community! Enjoy the blend of old-world charm and modern luxury in a beautifully appointed beach house. Nestled among pristine white sand dunes and surrounded by one of Florida's most popular state parks, Grayton Beach offers a unique retreat. Explore the area by bike, visit local shops and restaurants, or stroll to the beach on some of the most unspoiled sands along 30A. This home, built by a descendant of Grayton Beach's founding fathers, boasts custom features throughout. Relax on the porch bed swing after a day at the beach, or let the kids retreat to the carriage house for some quiet time.

ABOUT THE AREA: The best of both worlds: be on the Gulf, walkable to the famous Red Bar (wait for the buzzer while relaxing on the covered porch) or Western Lake for paddle boarding. And if shopping is your thing, you have plenty in Grayton Beach, Seaside and Watercolor as well as farmers markets in both Watercolor and Seaside.

BEACH ACCESS: Grayton Dunes is the beach access closest to home! When you get to the end of your road, take a left and the gorgeous turquoise water is directly ahead! Grayton Beach State Park is one of the most beautiful parks in the area. If you want access to winding trails amongst the massive dunes, strolling along a coastal dune lake as well as a stunning beach with all the facilities, then this is a perfect option. There's a small entry fee for day use at 357 Main Park Road, Santa Rosa Beach.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 Queen \& Bunk Room (Twin/Twin)
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 King Master Ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Carriage House (Queen Trundle \& Full Sleeper Couch)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Adult Bikes
• Carriage House (Studio w/ Queen trundle \& Full Sleeper Sofa)
• Covered Porches
• Outdoor Shower
• Propane Grill
• Coffee Maker -- drip or traditional
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows 1 pet for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces with no overflow parking.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
